rom.notes: Final full build: Classic DeX, USB debugging from the first boot (prompt during setup), full storage (earlier builds: 30 GB), Magisk 31.1 app, Wi-Fi calling on by default, VoNR switch, face unlock scan and preview, double tap to wake, 4x faster installer. Install from a PC; for the full storage use install (erases data), update keeps the old size.

packs.title: Ruan Fixes 3.0
packs.description: Update notifications (every 6 h, daily, weekly or never), history of installed fixes, switches for USB debugging at boot and root for ADB shell; fixes the crash on open.

packs.title: SELinux log noise
packs.description: Silences four harmless SELinux denials (fonts, efs, em_version) logged at boot.

packs.title: USB debugging and adb root after reboot
packs.description: Starts USB debugging at boot without toggling it, and allows su from adb shell (deny Shell in Magisk to stop that).
